newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal H2 industrial output seen weak.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal H2 industrial output seen weak.

text.p: Low domestic and foreign demand will keep Portuguese industrial production weak in the second half of 1996, according to a study conducted by the Economy Ministry.
The Ministry said most of the 25 sectors analysed in the study would continue to contract in the third quarter with the exception of the car and paper industries.
It said some sectors might benefit from increased public works investment and it expected exports to begin to pick up.
In May Portugal's industrial production index rose 3.2 percent from the previous month but was down 0.4 percent year-on-year.
